aniimo-release-date.title: Aniimo Release Date: Global Launch Time and Pre-Registration
aniimo-release-date.subtitle: Aniimo launches globally on September 16, 2026 at 10:00 UTC+8.
aniimo-release-date.lead: Aniimo is scheduled to launch globally on September 16, 2026 at 10:00 UTC+8 as a free-to-play title. Steam may show September 15 because storefront dates vary by region and time zone.

body.c: What is the Aniimo release date?
The PlayStation Store states that Aniimo will officially launch on September 16, 2026 at 10:00 UTC+8. That is September 16 at 02:00 UTC and September 15 at 10:00 PM Eastern Daylight Time.
Why does Steam show September 15?

The Steam listing checked in the United States displays Sep 15, 2026. This is consistent with a simultaneous global launch crossing calendar dates in different time zones; the UTC+8 time above is the explicit launch time published by PlayStation.
Is Aniimo free to play?
Yes. PlayStation, Xbox and Steam describe Aniimo as free-to-play. Optional pre-order packs and in-app purchases are separate from access to the base game.
Can I pre-register now?
The official Aniimo website currently offers pre-registration and links to its supported storefronts. Use the official site or the store page for your platform rather than unofficial download sites.
Release information was last checked on August 29, 2026. Store dates can display differently by region.

body.c: Is Aniimo on Steam?
Yes. Steam App 4126040 is the official listing linked by Aniimo. It currently lists Windows support, free-to-play access and Pawprint Studio as developer and publisher.
Is Aniimo on PS5 and Xbox?
Yes. The official site links a PlayStation Store concept page and an Xbox store page. Xbox currently lists PC and Xbox Series X|S.
Is Aniimo coming to iPhone and Android?
The official website links both the App Store and Google Play. Availability, compatibility and download timing can vary by country, device and storefront.
Is Nintendo Switch confirmed?
No Nintendo Switch listing appears among the official platform links checked for this page. Treat Switch claims as unconfirmed unless Aniimo or Nintendo publishes an official listing.

what-is-aniimo.title: What Is Aniimo? Gameplay, Twine and Open-World Features
what-is-aniimo.subtitle: An official-source overview of Aniimo and how its core gameplay works.
what-is-aniimo.lead: Aniimo is a free-to-play creature-catching open-world RPG from Pawprint Studio. Players explore Idyll, capture Aniimo, Twine with collected creatures and take part in solo, multiplayer and competitive activities.

body.c: What kind of game is Aniimo?

Official store descriptions call Aniimo a next-generation creature-catching open-world RPG. Its core loop combines exploration, collecting creatures, using their abilities, solving puzzles and taking part in real-time battles and challenges.
What does Twine mean in Aniimo?

Twine lets a Pathfinder become an Aniimo they have collected and use that creature’s abilities. Official examples include gliding, diving and burrowing to explore, solve puzzles, battle and overcome environmental challenges.
How does catching work?

Official store text says players catch Aniimo with Aniipods, can set traps and must time catches. Creatures may appear according to environment, weather, phenomena and time of day. Exact probability formulas are not published in the sources used here.
Does Aniimo have multiplayer?
Yes. Steam lists multiplayer, PvP, online co-op and cross-platform multiplayer. Xbox describes Egg Heist as a real-time PVEVP activity for three-player teams, alongside solo and multiplayer play.
Who makes Aniimo?
Steam lists Pawprint Studio as both developer and publisher.
This overview separates verified official features from dex stats, type multipliers and catch-rate formulas that remain under review.

is-aniimo-free-to-play.subtitle: Aniimo is officially listed as a free-to-play game on major storefronts.
is-aniimo-free-to-play.lead: Yes. Steam, PlayStation and Xbox describe Aniimo as free-to-play, so the base game does not require an upfront purchase.

body.c: Does Aniimo cost money?
The official Steam, PlayStation and Xbox listings label Aniimo as free-to-play. Players should be able to download and start the base game without buying it first.
Are there in-game purchases?
Store listings mention in-game purchases or optional packs. Exact prices and the full monetization model may vary by platform and region and should be checked on the official storefront at launch.
Where should I get Aniimo?
Use the storefront links on Aniimo's official website. Avoid websites offering unofficial installers, modified clients or early access downloads.

aniimo-twine-explained.title: Aniimo Twine Explained: Transformations, Exploration and Combat
aniimo-twine-explained.subtitle: Twine lets Pathfinders become collected Aniimo and use their abilities.
aniimo-twine-explained.lead: Twine is one of Aniimo's defining systems: a Pathfinder can become an Aniimo they have collected and use that creature's abilities in exploration, puzzles and battles.

body.c: What does Twine mean in Aniimo?
Official descriptions say players can Twine with collected Aniimo. Examples include gliding, diving and burrowing through the world while using creature-specific abilities.
What is Twine used for?
Exploring terrain and reaching new areas
Solving environmental puzzles
Using Aniimo abilities in real-time combat
Which Aniimo have each Twine ability?
A complete official ability-by-creature list has not been published in the sources used here. Community dex mappings remain under review.

aniimo-catching-guide.lead: Official store descriptions confirm that players use Aniipods, traps and timing to catch Aniimo, while environment, weather, phenomena and time of day affect appearances.

body.c: How does catching work in Aniimo?
Players explore habitats, encounter Aniimo and use Aniipods to catch them. Official text also mentions setting traps and choosing the right timing.
What affects where Aniimo appear?
Environment and habitat
Weather
Special phenomena
Time of day
Are catch rates known?

No verified probability formula or complete species catch-rate table appears in the official sources used here. Any calculator result should be treated as experimental until official data is available.

aniimo-multiplayer.title: Is Aniimo Multiplayer? Co-op, PvP and Egg Heist Explained
aniimo-multiplayer.subtitle: Official listings confirm multiplayer, online co-op, PvP and cross-platform play.
aniimo-multiplayer.lead: Aniimo supports solo and multiplayer activities. Steam lists PvP, online co-op and cross-platform multiplayer, while Xbox describes the three-player Egg Heist PVEVP mode.

body.c: Does Aniimo have co-op?
Yes. Steam lists online co-op and multiplayer. The final availability of specific activities may depend on platform, account and launch version.
Does Aniimo have PvP?
Steam lists PvP, and Xbox describes Egg Heist as a real-time PVEVP activity where three-player teams compete while facing environmental threats.
Is Aniimo cross-platform?
Steam lists cross-platform multiplayer. Official sources checked here do not yet explain every cross-save, account-linking or platform-combination detail.

aniimo-pre-registration.title: Aniimo Pre-Registration Guide: Official Links and Launch Status
aniimo-pre-registration.subtitle: Pre-register or wishlist Aniimo through the links on its official website.
aniimo-pre-registration.lead: Aniimo's official website provides pre-registration and storefront links. Availability and the wording of each action can differ by platform and region.

body.c: How do I pre-register for Aniimo?
Open Aniimo's official website, choose your platform and follow the linked storefront. Depending on the platform, the action may appear as pre-register, wishlist or pre-order.
Does pre-registration give rewards?
Reward details can change and may vary by campaign or region. Confirm any reward on the official Aniimo site or storefront before relying on it.
When does Aniimo launch?
The PlayStation Store states September 16, 2026 at 10:00 UTC+8. Storefront dates may display the previous calendar day in some time zones.
